messages:
Ana R.: Heads-up — Wednesday release train. Small infra routing change + embeddings quant tweak. Planning slot 09:30-11:00 PT. Who can own the deploy and smoke?
Jordan K.: I can own the deploy window. Will be online from 09:15.
Samir Patel: I can run smoke checks and monitor traces. Add me to the pager for 09:15-11:30.
Priya Nair: I'll do the post-canary quality checks on production prompts at 30/60/100% ramp.
Maria L.: Rolling back is on me if anything looks off on latency > 200ms or error rate spike > 1%.
Kevin T.: I'll pre-stage the infra change in staging at 06:00 PT and post the exact commit IDs here.
deploy-bot: Automated note — release train slot reserved: 2025-11-12 09:30-11:00 PT (slot_id: RT-20251112-4).
Ana R.: Thanks. @Jordan K. can you confirm the deploy playbook and the canary steps? Put the checklist in thread.
Jordan K.: Copying playbook snippet:
```
- Preflight: infra smoke + DB migrations (no-op)
- Deploy canary (10%) -> wait 5m -> run smoke
- Ramp 30% -> wait 10m -> run quality checks
- Ramp 60% -> wait 10m -> final perf checks
- Ramp 100% -> monitor 30m
- If issues -> rollback to tag: v-release-20251112-pre
```
Samir Patel: Smoke checklist (quick):
1) curl https://api.redwood.test/health -> 200
2) curl /v1/generate with test prompt -> tokens within baseline
3) check `llm-serving` pod logs for `KV cache` warnings
4) traces: p50/p95 for generate endpoint < 120ms/250ms

Priya Nair: For quality checks I'll use prompt set `release_smoke_v3` and watch hallucination/regression metrics in Optimize dashboard. Will report pass/fail in thread.
Kevin T.: Pre-staged commit IDs: infra-change: 12ab9f1, quant-tweak: 7d3f4a2. Staging run looked clean; shared perf graphs in console.
Maria L.: Rollback command (if needed): `kubectl rollout undo deployment/llm-serving --to-revision=release-20251112-pre` — make sure to pin model variants to previous tag.
Ana R.: Can we assign a notifier for customer-facing routes? We need someone to flip fallback routing if canary triggers. @Jordan K.?
Jordan K.: Yep, I'll flip fallback routing and coordinate with Support. I'll also post the canary results at each ramp step.
Samir Patel: I'll wire an automated smoke run after each ramp with this script: `./tools/smoke/run_smoke.sh --suite release_smoke_v3 --env prod` and post results.
Priya Nair: If quality fails at 30% I'll pause ramp and triage with Samir + Jordan. Escalation: @Ana R. then @Maria L. for rollback decision.
Kevin T.: One ask: please avoid long-running large batching config changes in same window — keeps rollback simpler.
Ana R.: Noted. Last ask: @everyone add your on-call alias to the thread if you're the owner for the window. I'll create the deploy notes doc after this thread and tag it in the release train. :thumbsup:
Jordan K.: Added on-call: @jk-deploy.
Samir Patel: Added: @sp-smoke.
Priya Nair: Added: @pn-quality.
Maria L.: Added: @ml-rollback.
Kevin T.: Added: @kt-infra.
Ana R.: Great. See you all 09:15 PT for final go/no-go check. If anything changes ping here. :rocket:
